sentences.text: Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V. Bhaskar Reddy

It is stated that the petitioners are the pattadars and possessors of various extents of the land
forming part of Sy.No.243 situated at Shanagonda Village, Odela Mandal, Peddapalli District.

of the petitioners is that the respondents authorities have identified their land for acquisition for the purpose of construction of Railway Over Bridge in lieu of level crossing No.27, Kazipet,
Ballarsha section at Sanagonda village, thereby respondent No.5 addressed a letter vide No.CW/DY.CE/CS/SC/ROR/ LA, dated 19.07.2024 to respondent No.2 for submitting proposal for acquisition of land admeasuring Ac.5.629 guntas situated in Shanagoda Village.

The grievance of the petitioners is that the lands proposed for acquisition by the respondent authorities are the only source of their livelihood and in the event of their lands are being acquired they lost their source of livelihood.

2. Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the respective parties and with their consent this writ petition is disposed of at the admission stage.
CVBR, J Wp_30897_2024 3.

Ms.Pranathi Reddy, learned Standing counsel appearing for respondent No.4 has placed on written instructions, wherein it is stated that the requisition authority i.e., respondent No.5 addressed a letter vide No.CW/DY.CE/CS/SC/ROB/LA, dated 19.07.2024 to respondent No.2 for acquisition of land for an extent of Ac.5.629 guntas situated at Shanagonda Village, Odela Mandal,
Peddapalli District.

Learned Standing Counsel further submitted that as on date no certain assessment/enjoyment survey is conducted and only an effort was made to demarcate the proposed alignment of the Railway Over Bridge in Shanagonda Village and the same was opposed by some of the villagers.

Learned Standing Counsel further submitted that if the petitioners' lands are being required for the purpose of construction of Railway Over Bridge, the respondent authorities will follow the procedure under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners made a representation before the respondent authorities that if any action initiated on the requisition proposal submitted by respondent Nos.4 and 5, the petitioners shall be put on notice to express their grievances.

Recording the submissions of the learned Standing Counsel appearing for respondent No.5 that there is no immediate threat of dispossession and they will follow the due procedure as and when the lands of the petitioners are required for acquisition, this writ petition is disposed of directing the Jeela Komuraiah vs State Of Of Telangana on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179320871/
